Name: Blue Eggs and Recipes
Author: i24KittyKat
Description:
[size=5]1.6 Compatible
This mod makes blue chickens lay blue eggs. Blue eggs make blue mayo and both can be used in recipes (most of the recipes are working now) 
[/size]Will be changing more of the ingredients later to match my other mods~
You can remove any recipe files that doesn't work or leave it as it only affects perfection level.

Mod inspired by Blue Chicken Eggs and Void Egg Recipes by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48767488]dragonsir[/url]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url] (for blue eggs, mayo, and recipes)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Install Producer Framework Mod[/url] (if you want blue mayo)
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
